name: validate_fixture_completeness
description: Test de validation que la fixture retourne un objet complètement initialisé
code:
def test_fixture_completeness(initial_state):
    """Validate that fixture returns fully initialized state."""
    assert initial_state is not None
    assert hasattr(initial_state, 'version')
    assert hasattr(initial_state, 'config')
    assert initial_state.version != ''
    assert len(initial_state.config) > 0
